config:
[mypy]
python_version = 3.11
strict = True
warn_unused_ignores = True
follow_imports = skip
mypy_path = scripts/guardrails/python:scripts/guardrails
show_error_codes = True
exclude = (^evaluation/|^\.tools/|^scripts/guardrails/fixtures/|^scripts/guardrails/vendor/)
# The pinned lizard distribution has no typing metadata; no source exceptions.

[mypy-*]
ignore_missing_imports = True

exclusion_rationales.scripts/guardrails/fixtures: checker input data, not maintained source

lizard.evidence: pinned distribution has no py.typed or bundled stubs
